policy_type.description: Fixed policy type for A2C algorithm.
policy_type.title: Policy Type

learning_rate.description: Step size for the optimizer (learning rate for the A2C policy update).
learning_rate.title: Learning Rate

n_steps.description: Number of forward steps to run for each environment before updating the network (typically small for A2C, e.g., 5).
n_steps.title: N Steps

gamma.description: Discount factor for future rewards (between 0 and 1).
gamma.title: Gamma

ent_coef.description: Entropy coefficient for the loss calculation. Higher values encourage more exploration.
ent_coef.title: Ent Coef

policy_type.description: Fixed policy type for Recurrent PPO.
policy_type.title: Policy Type

lstm_hidden_size.description: Size of the hidden state in the LSTM cell.
lstm_hidden_size.title: Lstm Hidden Size

n_lstm_layers.description: Number of stacked LSTM layers (usually 1 is sufficient).
n_lstm_layers.title: N Lstm Layers

shared_lstm.description: If true, uses a shared LSTM backbone for both Actor and Critic. If false, creates separate LSTMs.
shared_lstm.title: Shared Lstm

enable_critic_lstm.description: If true, includes an LSTM layer in the Critic network (only relevant if shared_lstm is false).
enable_critic_lstm.title: Enable Critic Lstm

learning_rate.description: Step size for the optimizer (learning rate for the PPO policy update). Smaller values often yield more stable PPO training.
learning_rate.title: Learning Rate

n_steps.description: Number of steps to run for each environment per update (PPO usually requires larger buffers than A2C, e.g., 128 or 256).
n_steps.title: N Steps

batch_size.description: Minibatch size used for each gradient update during the optimization passes.
batch_size.title: Batch Size

n_epochs.description: Number of optimization epochs (passes over the collected rollout data) when updating the network.
n_epochs.title: N Epochs

gamma.description: Discount factor for future rewards (between 0 and 1).
gamma.title: Gamma

ent_coef.description: Entropy coefficient for the loss calculation. Higher values encourage more exploration.
ent_coef.title: Ent Coef

clip_range.description: Range for clipping the surrogate objective. Prevents overly large policy updates to ensure stability (typically 0.2).
clip_range.title: Clip Range
